[[Protection Prayers]] | damagetype = [[Chaos damage]] | icon = Unicorn's Wrath }} [[Decade Rod "Unicorn's Valor"]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] obtained from [[Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith]] in [[Embark Beach]] during the [[Anniversary Celebration]] in exchange for 5 [[Proof of Legend|Proofs of Legend]]. == Stats == :[[Chaos damage|Chaos Dmg]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]]) :Chaos Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Healing Prayers]]) :Chaos Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Smiting Prayers]]) :Chaos Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Protection Prayers]]) :[[HCT|Halves casting time]] of [[spell]]s during [[Special event|Festival events]]. No effect in PvP.) :Crafted in tribute to an enduring legend. ==Skin== Uses the same skin as [[Unicorn's Wrath]]. ==Replica== This item cannot be replicated, as the universal "20% chance of halving casting time of spells" mod is not available outside of the unique Decade weapons and there are no other [[monk]] wands that deal chaos damage. ==Notes== * Like other equipment with multiple attribute requirements, the damage property will count once no matter how many different requirements are met. *This wand leaves behind a cutting trail of pink particles with each [[auto attack]] when the wielder is not under the effects of a [[form]] or [[tonic]]. Its auto attack projectiles also leave a trail of pink particles. *The inherent bonus [[HCT]] effect during events is only active during certain events ([[Canthan New Year]], [[Anniversary Celebration]], [[Dragon Festival]], [[Wayfarer's Reverie]], [[Halloween]], and [[Wintersday]]). * Without attribute points invested in Fast Casting, the inherent Fast Casting from this weapon provides a 21% reduction in casting times for [[spell]]s and [[signet]]s (only for [[mesmer skills]] or skills with a casting time greater or equal to 2 seconds) and a 15% reduction in recharge time for mesmer spells. {{anomaly|Unlike [[Decade Rod "All the World"]], [[Decade Rod "Antipode Alloy"]], [[Decade Rod "Undying Service"]], [[Decade Staff "Astral Pillar"]], [[Decade Staff "Underworld Pillar"]] and all non-Decade [[weapon]]s, this wand's appearance is not changed when the wielder is under the effects of a [[weapon spell]].}} ==Trivia== *Introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20250415|April 15, 2025 update]]. {{Decade weapons nav}} [[Category:Decade weapons|Wand]] [[Category:Unreplicable unique items]] [[Category:Multiple attribute items]]
